### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

Why Choose Hexcel

## Designed for Demanding Composite Applications

Hexcel empowers engineers and manufacturers with high-performance, certification-backed composite
materials. Our solutions are crafted to meet rigorous standards in both performance and delivery.
Preferred Carbon Fiber Developer

Hexcel is the world’s largest producer of aerospace carbon fiber and the leading supplier of carbon
fiber to U.S. military programs, making it an industry leader in advanced aerospace materials.

Honeycomb Manufacturing

Hexcel is the global leader in honeycomb manufacturing developing lightweight core material offering
exceptional light weighting, stiffness, and noise and energy absorption.

Product Safety

We are committed to providing support and customer care to help our customers safely handle and use
our products and enable them to fulfill their legal obligations.

Advanced Process Innovation

At Hexcel, a culture of innovation permeates our organization and is a strategic priority. Targeting
a breakthrough, aiming for what seems an unrealistic goal, or challenging some long-held paradigm
are springboards to discovery and thinking “outside the box.” We embrace the curiosity to explore
ideas, the passion to challenge the impossible and the conviction to succeed beyond expectations.

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

## Our Chemistry-as-a-Service™ is your Unfair Advantage.

### Dynamic Material Intelligence

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

### AI-Powered Process Optimization

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

Shrinking Our Footprint,
Not Our Ambition

By prioritizing energy efficiency and circularity, we aim for measurable reductions in emissions and
resource use every single year, even if that means rethinking our legacy formulas from the ground
up.

With you anything is possible

We are looking for the curious, the bold, and the nerds who want to question the status quo. If you
are ready to grow, we provide the safety, well-being, and technical tools to help you reach your
full potential.

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

Since 1985, ACP Composites has specialized in designing and manufacturing custom composite
structures, plates, flat panels, and other customized products that change the way the world
approaches complex operating environments. By following the basic principle of “customer-centric
innovation,” ACP Composites has remained focused on developing products that meet the specialty
needs of customers in high-performance and critical industries. With a penchant for high-quality
composites, affordable options, and decades of successful customer partnerships under its belt, ACP
is driven to become the leading custom composite manufacturer for clients in the aerospace,
recreational, medical, and industrial sectors.

## Manufacturing

ACP Composites is proud to offer the most comprehensive collection of composite fabrication,

## Services

In addition to manufacturing custom composites, ACP offers a variety of additional value-added
services to help streamline production, keep projects on-time, and provide competitive pricing. From
sourcing initial materials to CNC machining and finishing your composite parts, to light assembly
work and ply cutting, ACP Composites is a one-stop shop giving clients access to pre and
post-production services needed to bring composite projects to life. Contact us today to learn more
about how we can help.

[ Contact Us ][200]
[ Learn More ][201]

## Quality Is Our Design

ACP Composites is an ISO 9001 and AS9100-certified composite manufacturing company specializing in
the world’s most advanced composite materials and crafting customized solutions for demanding
applications. Quality isn’t just what we deliver; it’s a driving force that guides our manufacturing
process from start to finish. From First Article Inspection (FAI) Reports to document control
systems and NIST-certified calibration practices, our composite manufacturing process delivers on
our customers’ expectations for excellence while deploying innovative quality techniques across the
company.

## Product Specialties

As an ISO 9001-certified custom composite manufacturer, ACP Composites is well-versed in delivering
advanced composite solutions built to custom specifications. We produce high-strength and low-weight
sandwich panels, laminates, composite tubes, and formed structures for demanding aerospace,
industrial, medical, and other technical applications.

## Sandwich Panels

ACP Composites produces lightweight, high-strength sandwich panels by bonding composite prepreg to
honeycomb or foam cores. Available in AL-X Aluminum, carbon fiber, and fiberglass, these panels
deliver exceptional stiffness-to-weight performance for aerospace and automotive applications.

[Learn More »][202]

## Laminates

ACP Composites manufactures custom laminates using epoxy resin systems and advanced fiber
reinforcements for strength, stiffness, and temperature resistance. Options include carbon fiber,
fiberglass, structural foam, and NOMEX honeycomb, tailored to precise performance requirements
across demanding industries.

[Learn More »][203]

## Composite Tubes

ACP Composites manufactures lightweight, high-strength composite tubes and rods using carbon fiber,
fiberglass, and Kevlar. Produced via roll wrapping, pultrusion, or filament winding, these tubes

## WHY ACP COMPOSITES?

Since 1985, ACP Composites has specialized in designing and manufacturing custom composite
structures, plates, flat panels, and other customized products that change the way the world
approaches complex operating environments. By following the basic principle of “customer-centric
innovation,” ACP Composites has remained focused on developing products that meet the specialty
needs of customers in high-performance and critical industries. With a penchant for high-quality
composites, affordable options, and decades of successful customer partnerships under its belt, ACP
is driven to become the leading custom composite manufacturer for clients in the aerospace,
recreational, medical, and industrial sectors.

## Services

In addition to manufacturing custom composites, ACP offers a variety of additional value-added
services to help streamline production, keep projects on-time, and provide competitive pricing. From
sourcing initial materials to CNC machining and finishing your composite parts, to light assembly
work and ply cutting, ACP Composites is a one-stop shop giving clients access to pre and
post-production services needed to bring composite projects to life. Contact us today to learn more
about how we can help.

## Quality Is Our Design

ACP Composites is an ISO 9001 and AS9100-certified composite manufacturing company specializing in
the world’s most advanced composite materials and crafting customized solutions for demanding
applications. Quality isn’t just what we deliver; it’s a driving force that guides our manufacturing
process from start to finish. From First Article Inspection (FAI) Reports to document control
systems and NIST-certified calibration practices, our composite manufacturing process delivers on
our customers’ expectations for excellence while deploying innovative quality techniques across the
company.

## Product Specialties

As an ISO 9001-certified custom composite manufacturer, ACP Composites is well-versed in delivering
advanced composite solutions built to custom specifications. We produce high-strength and low-weight
sandwich panels, laminates, composite tubes, and formed structures for demanding aerospace,
industrial, medical, and other technical applications.

## Sandwich Panels

ACP Composites produces lightweight, high-strength sandwich panels by bonding composite prepreg to
honeycomb or foam cores. Available in AL-X Aluminum, carbon fiber, and fiberglass, these panels
deliver exceptional stiffness-to-weight performance for aerospace and automotive applications.

[Learn More »][202]

## Laminates

ACP Composites manufactures custom laminates using epoxy resin systems and advanced fiber
reinforcements for strength, stiffness, and temperature resistance. Options include carbon fiber,
fiberglass, structural foam, and NOMEX honeycomb, tailored to precise performance requirements
across demanding industries.

[Learn More »][203]

## Composite Tubes

ACP Composites manufactures lightweight, high-strength composite tubes and rods using carbon fiber,
fiberglass, and Kevlar. Produced via roll wrapping, pultrusion, or filament winding, these tubes
maintain tight tolerances, outperform metals, and support machining, cutting, and finishing across
diverse applications.

[Learn More »][204]

ACP Composites engineers complex composite shapes using carbon fiber, fiberglass, and Kevlar to meet
specific structural needs. These custom geometries provide excellent strength-to-weight ratios,
dimensional stability, and design flexibility for aerospace, robotics, industrial, and sporting
goods applications.

# AEROVAC PROCESS MATERIALS

Aerovac is a** leading provider of process materials** essential to composite manufacturing in
Aerospace, Wind Energy, Marine, Motorsports and more. Products are efficiently delivered from **40+
distribution centers** across North America via our exclusive fleet of **privately owned trucks**.
Locations in the UK, Italy, France and South America combined with a network of authorized
distributors ensure Aerovac products are readily available worldwide. Our team of over
100 **technical product experts** can help your business innovate utilizing industry leading
technologies and composite supplies.

As a top composite process materials manufacturer, companies across a broad spectrum of industries
depend on our expertise. Whether it’s for Aerospace, Marine, Motorsports or Wind Energy, our
customers rely on us as their process materials manufacturer of choice. We’re entrusted to meet
their specific requirements to deliver the highest degrees of performance and reliability. As a
leading process materials supplier, our products serve an important role in manufacturing processes
such as vacuum bagging, prepreg processing, vacuum infusion, and more.

Breather Fabric

PRODUCTS


**BREATHER FABRIC**

Breather fabric is a 100% non-woven polyester or nylon fabric that is designed to allow airflow
throughout the vacuum bagging process as well as bleed out an excess resin in a composite part. It
allows great conformity around a composite part while under vacuum pressure. Aerovac manufactures
breather fabric in standard roll formats, slit widths, or cut shapes tailored to meet your
requirements.

breather fabric in standard roll formats, slit widths, or cut shapes tailored to meet your

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

NONGCHAOER Composite Materials Co. Ltd.,is a dynamic and forward-thinking sister company of ANJIE
Composite,established in 2019 and located in Jianhu High-tech Park,Yancheng City,Jiangsu Province

innovation,NONGCHAOER focuses on the manufacturing,development and application of advanced composite
materials to meet the growing demand in the market worldwide. Equipped with large facilities and
advanced machinery,it currently has more than 120 sets of various types of production equipment and
laboratory equipment. In 2022,it successfully passed the certification of "National Science and
Technology small and medium-sized enterprises",in 2023 it successfully passed the quality management
system certification,environmental management system certification,occupational health and safety
management system certification,SGS certification,and selected as the first batch of Yancheng
Engineering Technology Research Center.

*ABOUT US*

##### Composite Material Manufacturing:

Haining ANJIE Composite Materials Co. Ltd., is a reputable and established manufacturer of composite
materials,specializing in the production of carbon fiber,basalt fiber,aramid fiber,and fiberglass
products. With a strong presence in Haining City Zhejiang province,China since its establishment in
2004,ANJIE has built a robust brand known for its competitive pricing,superior quality,and
exceptional customer service with 20 years of experience in composite materials industry. Jiangsu
NONGCHAOER Composite Materials Co. Ltd.,is a dynamic and forward-thinking sister company of ANJIE
Composite,established in 2019 and located in Jianhu High-tech Park,Yancheng City,Jiangsu Province
with a total area of about 20,000 square meters. With a commitment to excellence and
innovation,NONGCHAOER focuses on the manufacturing,development and application of advanced composite
materials to meet the growing demand in the market worldwide. Equipped with large facilities and
advanced machinery,it currently has more than 120 sets of various types of production equipment and
laboratory equipment. In 2022,it successfully passed the certification of "National Science and
Technology small and medium-sized enterprises",in 2023 it successfully passed the quality management
system certification,environmental management system certification,occupational health and safety
management system certification,SGS certification,and selected as the first batch of Yancheng
Engineering Technology Research Center.

### Customized Compound Solutions

Since 2015, CCS is Bjørn Thorsen's dedicated brand for development of special TPE compounds,
bridging the gap between commercially available TPE grades from Bjørn Thorsen's distribution
portfolio and customers' unique needs.

[EXPLORE CCS][56]

### Acti-Tech™ Compatibilizer

Acti-Tech Compatibilizer is a unique and proprietary range of superior and functionalized
compatibilizers, used as impact modifiers of stiff polar engineering thermoplastics, coupling agents
enabling higher filler loadings, adhesion promoters on metal and polar substrates, as well as
performance booster of recycled feeds.

[EXPLORE ACTI-TECH][57]

EXPLORE OUR OWN BRANDS

### Nordic Formulation Technologies

Since 2017, Bjørn Thorsen offers various tailored liquid formulations (special coatings,
dispersions, additives, etc.) through its affiliated production company Nordic Formulation
Technology A/S (NFT). The company is based in Svendborg, Denmark.

[EXPLORE NFT][58]

EXPLORE OUR OWN BRANDS

### Digital Serigraphic Technologies

Since 2020, DST is a brand by Bjørn Thorsen, which combines company’s offering of consumables (PET
films, papers, inks and adhesives) for making heat transfers via traditional screenprinting, digital
hybrid printing, and DTF for textile decoration.

### Discover Bjørn Thorsen's Own Brands

Since 2015, Bjørn Thorsen offers customers more than just distributed specialty raw materials. To
answer customers’ specific requirements across a wide variety of industries the company offers R&D
support, tailor-made TPEs, powders and liquid formulations with laboratories and production
facilities in Denmark and France.

EXPLORE OUR OWN BRANDS

### Customized Compound Solutions

Since 2015, CCS is Bjørn Thorsen's dedicated brand for development of special TPE compounds,
bridging the gap between commercially available TPE grades from Bjørn Thorsen's distribution
portfolio and customers' unique needs.

[EXPLORE CCS][56]

EXPLORE OUR OWN BRANDS

### Acti-Tech™ Compatibilizer

Acti-Tech Compatibilizer is a unique and proprietary range of superior and functionalized
compatibilizers, used as impact modifiers of stiff polar engineering thermoplastics, coupling agents
enabling higher filler loadings, adhesion promoters on metal and polar substrates, as well as
performance booster of recycled feeds.

[EXPLORE ACTI-TECH][57]

EXPLORE OUR OWN BRANDS

### Nordic Formulation Technologies

Since 2017, Bjørn Thorsen offers various tailored liquid formulations (special coatings,
dispersions, additives, etc.) through its affiliated production company Nordic Formulation
Technology A/S (NFT). The company is based in Svendborg, Denmark.

[EXPLORE NFT][58]

EXPLORE OUR OWN BRANDS

### Digital Serigraphic Technologies

Since 2020, DST is a brand by Bjørn Thorsen, which combines company’s offering of consumables (PET
films, papers, inks and adhesives) for making heat transfers via traditional screenprinting, digital
hybrid printing, and DTF for textile decoration.

[EXPLORE DST][59]

One of the primary reasons to choose us is our commitment to innovation. We are constantly pushing
the boundaries of what is possible with traditional materials, and our aluminum honeycomb cores and
panels are a testament to this. These products offer a lightweight yet incredibly strong and durable
solution for a wide range of applications. Whether it is for architectural decoration, rail transit,
or mechanical equipment, our products have been proven to deliver exceptional performance and
reliability.

Furthermore, our dedication to quality is another reason to choose us. We understand that our
clients rely on us to provide them with products that meet the highest standards, and we take this
responsibility very seriously. Our aluminum honeycomb cores and panels are meticulously manufactured
using the latest technologies and production processes to ensure that they meet the strictest
quality requirements. This allows our clients to have peace of mind knowing that they are getting
products that are reliable, durable, and long-lasting.

Additionally, our customer-centric approach sets us apart from the competition. We understand that
each project is unique, and our clients have specific requirements and expectations. This is why we
work closely with our clients to understand their needs and provide them with tailored solutions
that will address their specific challenges. Our team of experts is dedicated to providing
exceptional customer service and support at every step of the process, from initial consultation to
product delivery and beyond.

Furthermore, our commitment to sustainability is another reason to choose us. We understand the
importance of using materials that are not only high-performing but also environmentally friendly.
Our aluminum honeycomb cores and panels are 100% recyclable, and we ensure that our production
processes adhere to the highest sustainability standards. This allows our clients to contribute to a
greener and more sustainable future while also benefiting from innovative and high-quality

easy-to-handle product. This makes it a desirable choice for applications where weight reduction is
crucial, such as in the aerospace and automotive industries. The two outer skins are also made from
steel, providing additional protection and durability to the structure.One of the key advantages of

lightweight yet highly durable structures. This makes it an ideal choice for applications where
weight reduction is important, such as in the aerospace and automotive industries. The high strength

ensure the safety and durability of the aircraft, making it a preferred choice for manufacturers and
operators.In the automotive industry, Steel Honeycomb Sheet is used in the manufacturing of vehicle

efficiency and overall performance, while its high strength helps to enhance the safety and

increasingly popular choice for use in vehicle construction.In the construction industry, Steel

### INNOVATE. DEVELOP. REALIZE.

Bei CIKONI kombinieren wir Kreativität, technische Perfektion und unternehmerisches Denken. Wir sind
der führende Gesamtlösungsanbieter für anspruchvolle Leichtbauprojekte mit modernen

BERATUNG & INNOVATION | ENGINEERING | AUTOMATION

## CIKONI: CFK-Engineering für Pioniere

CIKONI ist ein spezialisiertes Ingenieurbüro für innovative Leichtbau- und Faserverbundlösungen mit
fortgeschrittenen Verbundwerkstoffen, wie kohlefaserverstärktem Kunststoff (CFK).

CIKONI – das bedeutet ganzheitliche spezialisierte Ingenieurdienstleistungen entlang der gesamten
Prozesskette und schließt die Entwicklung von Leichtbauprodukten und den notwendigen
Fertigungsverfahren ein. Mit unserem Expertenteam schließen wir im Kundenauftrag Technologie- und
Wissenslücken und realisieren einen meßbaren Beitrag zu geringerem Energieverbrauch, höherer
Performance und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Zur Detaillierung und Absicherung von Strukturkomponenten nutzen wir modernste
Konstruktionswerkzeuge, zukunftsweisende Simulationsmethoden und fasergerechte FEM-Berechnung (z.B.
Festigkeit, Steifigkeit, Crash). In der Prozessentwicklung realisieren wir skalierbare und
automatisierbare Lösungen für die effiziente Fertigung von Carbonbauteilen.

[FEM Simulation von CFK Bauteilen]

## Was machen wir im CFK-Leichtbau?

[ Leichtbau][32] [ Testing][33] [ Automation][34] [ Drucktanks][35]

Leichtbau ist ein Entwicklungsprinzip, bei dem wir die Erfüllung einer Funktion mit möglichst
geringem Einsatz an Material und damit Gewicht realisieren. Dabei setzen wir sowohl
leichtbaubezogene Konstruktionsprinzipien als auch Hochleistungswerkstoffe wie CFK/Carbon ein, um
das Gewichtsziel zu erreichen. Ein wichtiges Werkzeug ist die anisotrope Finite Elemente Simulation,
die es uns erlaubt Konzepte frühzeitig zu validieren und in späten Projektphasen weitgehend zu
optimieren.

Unser übergeordnetes Ziel ist es dabei , das richtige wirtschaftliches Maß für jeden Kunden zu
finden. Zwischen Ultraleichtbau, wie er im Rennsport oder der Luftfahrt praktiziert wird und einer
reinen Optimierung identifizieren wir die richtige Stufe für jeden Kunden und jeden Anwendungsfall.
Dabei dienen uns Hybridkonstruktionen aus Metall und Verbundwerkstoffen oftmals als Enabler.

Mehr zur [Entwicklung von CFK-Bauteilen][36].

Für den Leichtbau spielt das Testing für uns eine doppelte Rolle. Einerseits sind wir gerade bei
komplexen Faserverbundwerkstoffen auf umfangreiche Inputdaten für die Simulation angewiesen.
Andererseits werden Leichtbauteile oftmals an die Grenzen ihrer Belastbarkeit hin entwickelt. Daher
müssen sie über Komponentenversuche bezüglich ihrer Funktionserfüllung validiert werden.

Bei CIKONI arbeiten wir mit mehr als 20 verschiedenen Laboren, Prüfzentren und Versuchseinrichtungen
zusammen. Dies erlaubt uns die durchgängige Realisierung von Versuchen vom Coupon bis zum
Systemversuch zu wirtschaftlichen Konditionen und mit durchgängiger technischer Begleitung anbieten
zu können.

Mehr zum [Testing mit Verbundwerkstoffen][37].

Der Großteil der Fertigung von Carbon Composites erfolgt nach wie vor über manuelle
Fertigungsverfahren. Die Kosten manueller Fertigung übersteigen dabei die Materialkosten um ein
Vielfaches. Bei CIKONI entwickeln wir daher sowohl Leichtbauteile, die effizient gefertigt werden
können, realisieren aber auch Fertigungsprozesse und automatisierte Maschinen für die Herstellung
der Komponenten.

Ein besonderer Fokus ist dabei die Skalierbarkeit unserer Fertigungskonzepte, so dass mit
überschaubaren Mitteln ein Einstieg in die (Teil-)Automatisierung erfolgen kann, das
Fertigungsprinzip jedoch bei Bedarf multipliziert werden kann. Unser Schwerpunkt sind die
Entwicklung innovativer Verfahren, das automatisierte Preforming und die Fertigung auf Basis der
Wickeltechnologie.

Mehr zur [Automatisierung im Leichtbau][38].

[Leichtbau-Laderaumsystem aus Carbonfaser]

## CIKONI: CFK-Engineering für Pioniere

CIKONI ist ein spezialisiertes Ingenieurbüro für innovative Leichtbau- und Faserverbundlösungen mit
fortgeschrittenen Verbundwerkstoffen, wie kohlefaserverstärktem Kunststoff (CFK).

CIKONI – das bedeutet ganzheitliche spezialisierte Ingenieurdienstleistungen entlang der gesamten
Prozesskette und schließt die Entwicklung von Leichtbauprodukten und den notwendigen
Fertigungsverfahren ein. Mit unserem Expertenteam schließen wir im Kundenauftrag Technologie- und
Wissenslücken und realisieren einen meßbaren Beitrag zu geringerem Energieverbrauch, höherer
Performance und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Zur Detaillierung und Absicherung von Strukturkomponenten nutzen wir modernste
Konstruktionswerkzeuge, zukunftsweisende Simulationsmethoden und fasergerechte FEM-Berechnung (z.B.
Festigkeit, Steifigkeit, Crash). In der Prozessentwicklung realisieren wir skalierbare und
automatisierbare Lösungen für die effiziente Fertigung von Carbonbauteilen.

[FEM Simulation von CFK Bauteilen]

## Was machen wir im CFK-Leichtbau?

[ Leichtbau][32] [ Testing][33] [ Automation][34] [ Drucktanks][35]

Leichtbau ist ein Entwicklungsprinzip, bei dem wir die Erfüllung einer Funktion mit möglichst
geringem Einsatz an Material und damit Gewicht realisieren. Dabei setzen wir sowohl
leichtbaubezogene Konstruktionsprinzipien als auch Hochleistungswerkstoffe wie CFK/Carbon ein, um
das Gewichtsziel zu erreichen. Ein wichtiges Werkzeug ist die anisotrope Finite Elemente Simulation,
die es uns erlaubt Konzepte frühzeitig zu validieren und in späten Projektphasen weitgehend zu
optimieren.

Unser übergeordnetes Ziel ist es dabei , das richtige wirtschaftliches Maß für jeden Kunden zu
finden. Zwischen Ultraleichtbau, wie er im Rennsport oder der Luftfahrt praktiziert wird und einer
reinen Optimierung identifizieren wir die richtige Stufe für jeden Kunden und jeden Anwendungsfall.
Dabei dienen uns Hybridkonstruktionen aus Metall und Verbundwerkstoffen oftmals als Enabler.

Mehr zur [Entwicklung von CFK-Bauteilen][36].

Für den Leichtbau spielt das Testing für uns eine doppelte Rolle. Einerseits sind wir gerade bei
komplexen Faserverbundwerkstoffen auf umfangreiche Inputdaten für die Simulation angewiesen.
Andererseits werden Leichtbauteile oftmals an die Grenzen ihrer Belastbarkeit hin entwickelt. Daher
müssen sie über Komponentenversuche bezüglich ihrer Funktionserfüllung validiert werden.

Bei CIKONI arbeiten wir mit mehr als 20 verschiedenen Laboren, Prüfzentren und Versuchseinrichtungen
zusammen. Dies erlaubt uns die durchgängige Realisierung von Versuchen vom Coupon bis zum
Systemversuch zu wirtschaftlichen Konditionen und mit durchgängiger technischer Begleitung anbieten
zu können.

Mehr zum [Testing mit Verbundwerkstoffen][37].

Der Großteil der Fertigung von Carbon Composites erfolgt nach wie vor über manuelle
Fertigungsverfahren. Die Kosten manueller Fertigung übersteigen dabei die Materialkosten um ein
Vielfaches. Bei CIKONI entwickeln wir daher sowohl Leichtbauteile, die effizient gefertigt werden
können, realisieren aber auch Fertigungsprozesse und automatisierte Maschinen für die Herstellung
der Komponenten.

Ein besonderer Fokus ist dabei die Skalierbarkeit unserer Fertigungskonzepte, so dass mit
überschaubaren Mitteln ein Einstieg in die (Teil-)Automatisierung erfolgen kann, das
Fertigungsprinzip jedoch bei Bedarf multipliziert werden kann. Unser Schwerpunkt sind die
Entwicklung innovativer Verfahren, das automatisierte Preforming und die Fertigung auf Basis der
Wickeltechnologie.

Mehr zur [Automatisierung im Leichtbau][38].

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

Join Coherent at Laser & Photonics Taiwan 2026, the premier annual event for the laser and photonics
industry, showcasing the latest advancements in advanced manufacturing, smart automation,
semiconductors, electric vehicles, and biomedicine. Visit us at Booth P502 to discover cutting-edge
laser solutions and photonics technologies designed to power the next generation of manufacturing
and industrial applications. Meet with our experts and explore how Coherent is enabling innovation
across industries.

Work with our engineers to optimize the design to achieve the best results using composites. This
includes part consolidation compared to other traditional styles.

### Tool Build

CME will build your tools to deliver your program on time and on budget and work closely with our
tool suppliers both nationally and internationally.

### Material Development

CME will formulate a material to meet unique requirements for structural performance, impact
absorption, food safe, fire resistance, electrical insulation.

### Material Compounding

CME will manufacture you engineered raw materials in-house to ensure the quality. This gives our
customers a unique difference over imports and competitors.

### Validation

CME will validate materials and design before the tool build allowing for any changes to improve
performance to be made.

### Manufacture

CME will manufacture and assemble your product if required. This can also include painting with a
Class A finish. We will also provide ongoing engineering support.

# Composite-Expo 2027 - 19th edition of the International Specialized Exhibition on raw materials,

[12]

 

[arr or]  **Dates:** March 16 - 18, 2027

[arr or]  **Venue: **[Pavilion 1, Hall 1 and 4, IEC Crocus Expo, Moscow, Russia][88]

[arr or]  **Organizer: **[Mir-Expo Exhibition Company LLC][89]

[arr or]  **Under support of:** Russian Union of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs  [rspp]


[[Get an invitation card to the Composite Expo exhibition]][90]     [[Book a booth at the Composite
Expo Exhibition]

][91]

17th Composite-Expo 2025 Video Report




Composite-Expo 2026 photos:

Composite-Expo 2025 Exhibitors Interviews:

─┬─
 │ 
─┴─

 * More videos on [Composite-Expo YouTube Channel][92]. Or in the [Video gallery][93].


During past few years composite materials have been gradually developed and spread in numerous
fields of Industry. From the beginning composites were created as materials with specials features
for aeronautical and military fields, but now they are widely spread in a number of civil
applications such as automotive, marine, wind energy, construction, water treatment and many others.

**18th Exhibition "Composite-Expo"** is a unique exhibition event in Russia and is a platform for
development and introduction of composite technologies and materials in different branches of
industry. Many Russian and foreign companies participate in the event such as Technologiya ONPP,
RT-Khimkompozit, Stupino Glass Reinforced Plastics Plant, Akzo Nobel N.V., Evonik, OCV Steklovolokno
(OCV Reinforcements) are already exhibitors of the event.

** **

**The event purpose is defined by three components:**
* Industrial and Economic Relations' Development;
* Scientific and Technical Information Exchange;
* Wide introduction and application of innovative technologies of composite materials manufacturing
  and introduction.
  

**In 2026, on the space about 15000 sq. m. there situated 294 exhibitors, including 135 national
(domestic) companies and 159 foreign ones from 6 countries. More than 7500 people visited the shows
and 92% of them were specialists in different fields of industry.**

It witnesses growing demands of the Russian market to use modern innovation materials and
technologies in different industries.

 

**Composite-Expo is dedicated to the following markets:**
Aeronautic, Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, Construction, Wind Energy, Civil Engineering, Railway,
Consumer Goods, Electronics, Boat & Shipbuilding, Medical, Sports & Leisure.

 

General Exhibition Subjects:
* Raw Materials for Composite Materials Producing, Components: resins, additives, thermoplastics,

 * More videos on [Composite-Expo YouTube Channel][92]. Or in the [Video gallery][93].


During past few years composite materials have been gradually developed and spread in numerous
fields of Industry. From the beginning composites were created as materials with specials features
for aeronautical and military fields, but now they are widely spread in a number of civil
applications such as automotive, marine, wind energy, construction, water treatment and many others.

**18th Exhibition "Composite-Expo"** is a unique exhibition event in Russia and is a platform for
development and introduction of composite technologies and materials in different branches of
industry. Many Russian and foreign companies participate in the event such as Technologiya ONPP,
RT-Khimkompozit, Stupino Glass Reinforced Plastics Plant, Akzo Nobel N.V., Evonik, OCV Steklovolokno
(OCV Reinforcements) are already exhibitors of the event.

** **

**The event purpose is defined by three components:**
* Industrial and Economic Relations' Development;
* Scientific and Technical Information Exchange;
* Wide introduction and application of innovative technologies of composite materials manufacturing
  and introduction.
  

**In 2026, on the space about 15000 sq. m. there situated 294 exhibitors, including 135 national
(domestic) companies and 159 foreign ones from 6 countries. More than 7500 people visited the shows
and 92% of them were specialists in different fields of industry.**

It witnesses growing demands of the Russian market to use modern innovation materials and
technologies in different industries.

 

**Composite-Expo is dedicated to the following markets:**
Aeronautic, Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, Construction, Wind Energy, Civil Engineering, Railway,
Consumer Goods, Electronics, Boat & Shipbuilding, Medical, Sports & Leisure.

 

General Exhibition Subjects:
* Raw Materials for Composite Materials Producing, Components: resins, additives, thermoplastics,
  carbon fiber etc.;
* Reinforcing materials and Modifiers;
* Glass fiber, Carbon Fibre Reinforced Plastic, Basalt Plastic, Wood-polymer composites (WPC),
  Artificial Stone, Artificial Marble, Metal Composites, Nanocomposites, Bio-based composites etc.;
* Semi-finished and intermediate products (prepregs);
* Non-woven materials; textile-based composites;
* Additive technologies, 3-D printing;
* Composites Based Industrial (Finished) Products;
* Joining Systems Intended for Composites Based Products;
* Manufacture Technologies Provided for Composite Materials of Special and Defined Properties;
* Surface Treatment Technologies;
* Equipment and Technologies for Composite Materials Producing;
* Composite Materials Treatment Tooling;
* Measuring and Testing Equipment;
* Certification and Technical Regulations;
* CAD/CAM;
* Recycling.

# Manufacturing Software for Composite Materials

Transform your composite manufacturing processes with **CompositeOS **- where advanced manufacturing
**planning and operating software** meet in the cloud. Designed for the unique needs of the
composite industry, our platform delivers superior optimized planning, traceability, and operational
efficiency. CompositeOS is your manufacturing company's new operating backbone.

[ Let's work together!][4]

* Transform planned projects into Kanban work schedules for every team and operator
* Know the status of every project, task and ressource at any time
* Ensure on-time delivery of projects and parts

###### Navigating the Complexity of Fiber-Reinforced Materials

## Composite Materials are complex. So is Manufacturing.

[ Read more about us][8]

In the dynamic world of composite materials, where **performance**, **know how**, and the relentless
pursuit of **perfection **are not just goals but the essence of every endeavor. Handling
fiber-reinforced materials requires not just skill but a passion for pushing the boundaries of
what’s possible, blending an array of materials through processes that are as complex as they are
critical. Every step, every decision, reflects a commitment to excellence, with the quality of your
output distinguishing groundbreaking success from the ordinary.

In this intricate dance of precision, where **countless individuals, suppliers, materials, and
machines** come together to weave the very fabric of tomorrow’s structures, CompositeOS emerges as
the perfect tool to manage this complexity. Crafted exclusively for the nuanced demands of composite
material manufacturing, it is more than software—it is a celebration of the industry’s unyielding
drive towards perfection.

###### Designed for Composite Materials Manufacturing

## Made by Composite Materials Experts for your Success.

Composite materials competence, software expertise and customer orientation from a single source.

Whether you manufacture components using the autoclave prepreg process or resin transfer moulding,
we have the composite-specific tools, customizable modules and expertise to digitalize your
processes. In addition, compositeOS offers a number of characteristics that are aimed precisely at
the success of your composite materials business.

[ How it works][9]

##### (Cost-) Efficiency

We believe software must be affordable and deliver measurable efficiency boosts for your operation.

##### Transparency and Oversight

In composites, oversight is key. We provide software based tools to track customer acquisition,
manufacturing progress and quality metrics.

##### Convenience and Support

Typically, software is not a core competence of composite manufacturers. That’s why we devote time
to consult our customers, plan the project transparently and provide support beyond implementation.

##### Digital Empowerment

Digital processes increase employee satisfaction, boost efficiency and offer unlimited new business
opportunities through higher customer satisfaction.

###### Your Composite business reinforced by a digital thread

## A few things we’re great at

##### Fast Quoting

Use smart automation for fast quoting of composite manufacturing projects based on CAD files and ply
books. Change flexibly as you wish.

### Aircraft New Generation Patriot

ANG-01 to 5-miejscowy lekki samolot nowej generacji, zaprojektowany i wyprodukowany w 2019 roku
przez firmę Aircraft New Generation Patriot . Bazuje na wcześniejszym modelu LA-50, ale jest
znacznie ulepszony dzięki zastosowaniu nowoczesnych materiałów z włókna węglowego (carbon fiber), co
pozwoliło zmniejszyć masę własną do około 380 kg, zwiększyć wytrzymałość konstrukcji i poprawić
charakterystykę lotu. Samolot wyróżnia się łatwością obsługi, wysokim poziomem bezpieczeństwa (m.in.
system ratunkowy z spadochronem), niezawodnością oraz parametrami konkurującymi z najlepszymi
światowymi produktami w klasie lekkiej awiacji ogólnej (general aviation). Wyposażony w chowane
podwozie, silnik Rotax 915 iS (141 KM) oraz nowoczesną awionikę.

##### Metamorphose

"Pierwsza edycja targów Composite Poland umożliwiła przedstawienie oferty przed szerokim gronem

Menadżer

##### BOSMAL

"Wydarzenie było dla nas doskonałą okazją do nawiązania nowych kontaktów biznesowych, wymiany wiedzy
oraz zaprezentowania naszych rozwiązań w gronie ekspertów branżowych. Doceniamy wysoki poziom

merytorycznym Polskiego Klastra Technologii  Kompozytowych (PKTK), pełniącego rolę patrona I edycji
targów. Doceniamy wysoki poziom organizacyjny targów oraz nowoczesne zaplecze PTAK  Warsaw Expo,
które stworzyło komfortowe warunki do rozmów i spotkań branżowych."

Kierownik Zespołu Marketingu i Analizy Rynku

Dyrektor Handlowy

podwozie, silnik Rotax 915 iS (141 KM) oraz nowoczesną awionikę.

New DEViCoRe Project Launched to Accelerate UK Composites Recycling Supply Chain
A new feasibility study, funded by Innovate UK, Delivering Economically Viable Composites Recycling
(DEViCoRe), has officially commenced with the aim of overcoming the barriers preventing the UK from
establishing a commercially viable composites recycling supply chain.

[Read more][101]
UK Composites Sector Reports Significant Health and Safety Improvements
The UK composites industry has recorded significant improvements in health and safety performance,
according to the latest annual Health & Safety Report published by Composites UK.

[Read more][102]
Composites UK Expands Membership to Include CMC and MMC Companies
To support the entire spectrum of composite materials innovation in the UK, Composites UK, the
premier trade association for the UK composites sector, has expanded its membership criteria to now
fully encompass companies working with Ceramic Matrix Composites (CMCs) and Metal Matrix Composites
(MMCs).

[Read more][103]

### Composites UK is the trade association for companies working in the UK’s fibre-reinforced
### composite supply chain.

Our key aim is to support companies and enable them to grow and succeed in this competitive global
market.

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

COMSOL Compiler™

Compile apps into standalone executable files that can be run by anyone, anywhere.

Manage and distribute your organization's apps and run them via web browser or thin client.

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

**Quick Facts**
* Founded in 1986
* 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world
* 500+ employees globally

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[**Vai ai nostri prodotti** ][25]
[[Rotolo di pre-preg]][26]
[Icona pre-preg]

## Pre-preg

Impregnazione di tessuti di cotone, fibre di vetro, poliestere, arammidiche, carbonio. Formulati con
resine fenoliche, epossidiche, termoplastiche con personalizzazioni ad hoc secondo le esigenze del
cliente.

[scopri di più][27]
[[Lastra di laminato termoindurente]][28]
[Icona Laminati]

## Laminati termoindurenti

Per utilizzi meccanici e dielettrici, realizziamo lastre con spessori da ca. 0,2 a 100 mm; formato
ca. 1230 x 2030 mm e presto sarà disponibile anche un nuovo formato ca. 1230 x 2500 mm. Su specifica
richiesta possiamo proporre grandi formati larghezza massima 1570 mm e lunghezza massima 5500 mm.

[scopri di più][29]
[[reti impregnate per trasformatori]][30]
[Icona rete impregnata]

## Reti impregnate per trasformatori

Reti in fibra di vetro impregnate con resine epossidiche. Tramite una speciale cottura risultano
polimerizzate completamente e consentono di rientrare in classe H, con resistenze termiche >200°C,
idonee per la costruzione di trasformatori in classe F1.

[scopri di più][31]
[[Rinforzi strutturali]][32]
[Icona rinforzo strutturale]

## Rinforzi strutturali

Impregnazione di speciali reti in fibre di vetro, carbonio, kevlar, per inglobamenti sia nel campo
dei materiali compositi che delle strutture civili.

[scopri di più][33]
[[immagine di resina termoindurente]][34]
[Icona resina]

## Resine Termoindurenti

Con modernissimi reattori e miscelatori prepariamo e formuliamo resine e miscele di resine. Vendiamo
inoltre preparazioni formulate ad hoc sulle esigenze applicative del cliente.

[scopri di più][35]
[[Esempi di tessuto in fibra di vetro]][36]
[Icona Fiberglass fabrics]

## Tessuti in fibra di vetro

Tessuti e reti di rinforzo.

[scopri di più][37]

## Benvenuti nel mondo

[LOGO CONDORDIELETRIC]

“Amiamo investire il nostro tempo per capire al meglio le vostre esigenze”

## Mission

Attivi da oltre 60 anni nel settore dei pre-impregnati, isolanti elettrici e materiali compositi,
sviluppiamo e realizziamo nella nostra sede produttiva materiali specifici per ogni applicazione
(elettromeccanica, elettrica e per il rinforzo strutturale). Forniamo inoltre assistenza tecnica in
molteplici settori.

[Scopri di più][38]

## Ricerca e sviluppo

Crediamo fermamente nella ricerca scientifica come strumento per una produzione qualitativa e ci
avvaliamo di macchinari all’avanguardia (di precisione) per lo sviluppo e la personalizzazione dei
nostri prodotti.

[Scopri di più][39]

## SERVIZI

“Il nostro obiettivo è aiutarvi a scegliere il prodotto che più si addice alle vostre esigenze,
garantendo una soddisfazione finale che riteniamo essere la nostra miglior pubblicità”

## Qualità

Eseguiamo test di controllo speciali utilizzando attrezzature di laboratorio innovative.

Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC)

Thermal-Mechanical Analysis (TMA)

Thermal-Dynamic-Mechanical Analysis (DMA)

Rheometer

## Certificazioni

CONDORDIELETRIC è certificata ISO 9001 : 2015 e opera secondo gli standard tecnici e ambientali per
garantire la migliore qualità ai propri clienti.

[Certificazione ISO 9001:2015]

## Assistenza

Siamo in grado di fornire assistenza tecnica in molti settori, sviluppando materiali specifici per
ogni l’applicazione.

[Immagine per servizio di supporto]

4

60+

Per utilizzi meccanici e dielettrici, realizziamo lastre con spessori da ca. 0,2 a 100 mm; formato
ca. 1230 x 2030 mm e presto sarà disponibile anche un nuovo formato ca. 1230 x 2500 mm. Su specifica
richiesta possiamo proporre grandi formati larghezza massima 1570 mm e lunghezza massima 5500 mm.

[scopri di più][29]
[[reti impregnate per trasformatori]][30]
[Icona rete impregnata]

## Reti impregnate per trasformatori

Reti in fibra di vetro impregnate con resine epossidiche. Tramite una speciale cottura risultano
polimerizzate completamente e consentono di rientrare in classe H, con resistenze termiche >200°C,
idonee per la costruzione di trasformatori in classe F1.

[scopri di più][31]
[[Rinforzi strutturali]][32]
[Icona rinforzo strutturale]

## Rinforzi strutturali

Impregnazione di speciali reti in fibre di vetro, carbonio, kevlar, per inglobamenti sia nel campo
dei materiali compositi che delle strutture civili.

[scopri di più][33]
[[immagine di resina termoindurente]][34]
[Icona resina]

## Resine Termoindurenti

Con modernissimi reattori e miscelatori prepariamo e formuliamo resine e miscele di resine. Vendiamo
inoltre preparazioni formulate ad hoc sulle esigenze applicative del cliente.

[scopri di più][35]
[[Esempi di tessuto in fibra di vetro]][36]
[Icona Fiberglass fabrics]

## Tessuti in fibra di vetro

Tessuti e reti di rinforzo.

[scopri di più][37]

## Benvenuti nel mondo

[LOGO CONDORDIELETRIC]

“Amiamo investire il nostro tempo per capire al meglio le vostre esigenze”

## Mission

Attivi da oltre 60 anni nel settore dei pre-impregnati, isolanti elettrici e materiali compositi,
sviluppiamo e realizziamo nella nostra sede produttiva materiali specifici per ogni applicazione
(elettromeccanica, elettrica e per il rinforzo strutturale). Forniamo inoltre assistenza tecnica in
molteplici settori.

[Scopri di più][38]

## Ricerca e sviluppo

Crediamo fermamente nella ricerca scientifica come strumento per una produzione qualitativa e ci
avvaliamo di macchinari all’avanguardia (di precisione) per lo sviluppo e la personalizzazione dei
nostri prodotti.

[Scopri di più][39]

## SERVIZI

“Il nostro obiettivo è aiutarvi a scegliere il prodotto che più si addice alle vostre esigenze,
garantendo una soddisfazione finale che riteniamo essere la nostra miglior pubblicità”

## Qualità

Eseguiamo test di controllo speciali utilizzando attrezzature di laboratorio innovative.

Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC)

Thermal-Mechanical Analysis (TMA)

Thermal-Dynamic-Mechanical Analysis (DMA)

Rheometer

## Certificazioni

CONDORDIELETRIC è certificata ISO 9001 : 2015 e opera secondo gli standard tecnici e ambientali per
garantire la migliore qualità ai propri clienti.

[Certificazione ISO 9001:2015]

## Assistenza

Siamo in grado di fornire assistenza tecnica in molti settori, sviluppando materiali specifici per
ogni l’applicazione.

Our Expertise, Your Advantage
* Innovative Design
  
  Advanced weaving and molding capabilities tailored to your needs.
* Comprehensive Manufacturing
  
  Full-spectrum capabilities from prepregging to assembly.
* Quality You Can Trust

* Global Reach
  
  Serving clients across aerospace, automotive, and industrial markets worldwide.
Industry-Recognized Composite Manufacturing Facilities

At Jiangyin Dongli New Materials Technology Co., Ltd., we have built a robust manufacturing base
covering 32,000㎡ to serve the evolving demands of industries worldwide. Our facilities are equipped
with advanced technology and tailored workflows, ensuring the higher standards in composite material
production.

**Precision environment:** Constant temperature workshop and 1.100,000-grade purification area to
ensure material integrity and production accuracy.

**Full range of capabilities:** From fiber weaving to prepreg production to integrated production of
advanced forming technologies such as RTM, 2.vacuum infusion and hot pressing.

**Sustainable processes:** Efficient use of resources and innovative design ensure environmentally
friendly production.

**High capacity:** The loom has a daily output of 4,000㎡, supported by an autonomous tension
control and feeding system.

Our facilities not only represent efficient manufacturing but also demonstrate our commitment to
advancing composite technology. By continuously investing in our infrastructure, we aim to redefine
both performance and sustainability in the industry.

control and feeding system.

#### ABOUT EVERGREEN

Evergreen is a company that brings together talents in the chemical industry. We have been paying
attention to the construction of industry talent pipelines. We focus on unsaturated polyester
resins, epoxy resin, vinyl resins, specialty additives, organic peroxides and other fields. We are
committed to brand development and evangelism, senior brand managers will use critical eyes to help
you find suitable solutions. Evergreen's talent pool continues to expand, not only limited to
Nouryon, AOC , Henkel, China Sinochem, Fuchen, Jushi, Ineos..........
"Insist on loyalty and sincerity as our core value"
As partners continue to learn and innovate, Evergreen will eventually become the cradle of chemical
experts.

[Learn More][151]

#### OUR MAIN PRODUCTS

Evergreen Chemicals Group is committed to be deeply involved in the composite materials industry and
to be the most reliable one-stop partener of our clients.

Our products lines are unsaturated polyester resin series, vinyl ester resin series, epoxy resin
series, organic peroxides series, as well as the glass fiber mats series. We mainly work with the
top famous brands in the world like Nouryon, Inoes, BASF, AOC and so on.

[Learn More][152]

#### OUR ADVANTAGES

1. Efficient Export Process: We provide full export certificates promptly, ensuring a streamlined
export process and allowing for faster delivery times.
2. Global Reach: With no district limitations, we have the capability to export our chemicals to
every corner of the world.
3. Technical Expertise: Our team consists of professionals with strong technical backgrounds.
4. Supply Reliability: We understand the importance of providing hot chemicals and addressing the
demand for short-supply chemicals.
5. Customer Trust and Global Market Presence: Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction
has earned us the trust of our clients.

#### OUR MARKETS

Evergreen Chemicals are experienced in exporting dangerous products to other countries. We deal with
clients from over 50 countries in the world. Evergreen Chemicals always keeps eyes on the newest
exporting policy on dangerous products to assure the delivery rate. Besides, multiple payment ways
are offered to clients.

#### THE LATEST NEWS

Evergreen Chemicals recently launched the "Sincerity Reading Club" to promote balance between work
and personal life among employees. The event featured discussions around "Nonviolent Communication"
to enhance communication skills and mental health, fostering a supportive, learning-focused
environment within the company.

[Learn More][153]

##### CONTACT US

Please contact us if any question you have or need a quotation of any product. Simply fill out the
form below and we will contact you ASAP.

#### ABOUT EVERGREEN

Evergreen is a company that brings together talents in the chemical industry. We have been paying
attention to the construction of industry talent pipelines. We focus on unsaturated polyester
resins, epoxy resin, vinyl resins, specialty additives, organic peroxides and other fields. We are
committed to brand development and evangelism, senior brand managers will use critical eyes to help
you find suitable solutions. Evergreen's talent pool continues to expand, not only limited to
Nouryon, AOC , Henkel, China Sinochem, Fuchen, Jushi, Ineos..........
"Insist on loyalty and sincerity as our core value"
As partners continue to learn and innovate, Evergreen will eventually become the cradle of chemical
experts.

[Learn More][151]

#### OUR MAIN PRODUCTS

Evergreen Chemicals Group is committed to be deeply involved in the composite materials industry and
to be the most reliable one-stop partener of our clients.

Our products lines are unsaturated polyester resin series, vinyl ester resin series, epoxy resin
series, organic peroxides series, as well as the glass fiber mats series. We mainly work with the
top famous brands in the world like Nouryon, Inoes, BASF, AOC and so on.

[Learn More][152]

#### OUR ADVANTAGES

1. Efficient Export Process: We provide full export certificates promptly, ensuring a streamlined
export process and allowing for faster delivery times.
2. Global Reach: With no district limitations, we have the capability to export our chemicals to
every corner of the world.
3. Technical Expertise: Our team consists of professionals with strong technical backgrounds.
4. Supply Reliability: We understand the importance of providing hot chemicals and addressing the
demand for short-supply chemicals.
5. Customer Trust and Global Market Presence: Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction
has earned us the trust of our clients.

#### OUR MARKETS

Evergreen Chemicals are experienced in exporting dangerous products to other countries. We deal with
clients from over 50 countries in the world. Evergreen Chemicals always keeps eyes on the newest
exporting policy on dangerous products to assure the delivery rate. Besides, multiple payment ways
are offered to clients.

#### THE LATEST NEWS

Evergreen Chemicals recently launched the "Sincerity Reading Club" to promote balance between work
and personal life among employees. The event featured discussions around "Nonviolent Communication"
to enhance communication skills and mental health, fostering a supportive, learning-focused
environment within the company.

[Learn More][153]

Please contact us if any question you have or need a quotation of any product. Simply fill out the
form below and we will contact you ASAP.

you can really understand—hurrah!

do we know so far about this most mysterious of forces?

[Orange Schlieren photograph of two supersonic jets flying upward]

Planes can trace their history back thousands of years to ancient myths and legends. Why have humans

Rivers and seas take a long time to recover from the effects of careless human treatment. What
causes pollution and what can we do to stop it?

[White electricity plug with two pins.]

lot more important in future.

Can we build a brave new world just by shuffling atoms and molecules under a microscope?

everything from electric cars to body scans at the hospital.

### [Gears][32]

Wheels with teeth carved around them can make you go faster or bump up your power—and here's how.

[A dry cell Ever Ready battery.]

### [Batteries][33]

We all need electricity, wherever we happen to be, so thank goodness for batteries—miniature power
plants you can carry in your pocket.

[A large electric motor from an electric lawn mower]

### [Electric motors][34]

These amazing machines turn electricity and magnetism into movement, powering everything from
handheld toothbrushes to bikes, cars, and trains.

[Conceptual artwork of a warming world.]

### [Global warming][35]

Climate scientists recently issued their strongest ever warning about the growing risks of
irreversible "global warming." If you find the subject baffling, try our easy-to-follow
introduction.

[Composite photo showing NASA supercomputer floating in a cloud]

### [Cloud computing][36]

Why buy yourself an expensive computer or programs to go with it when you can get access to
something just as good over the Internet? What are the benefits and drawbacks of working in "the
cloud"?

## What else is on our site?

The articles on our site are divided up into broad topical areas, listed below. We've also given you
a rough idea of the kind of questions you're going to find answers to in each section:

[Basic digital camera]

### [Communications][37]

Why do we bounce telephone calls off satellites? How do cellphones work? What's the difference
between digital radio and ordinary radio?

[Typical microcontroller microchip in a dual-in-line package.]

### [Computers][38]

How can you make a computer think like a human brain? Who invented the computer—and why on Earth did
it take them so long?

[A digital voltmeter standing with red and black probes attached, wired into a circuit to test a
simple 1.5-volt battery.]

### [Electricity and electronics][39]

What's the difference between "electric" and "electronic"? How can you make coffee with a stream of
electrons? How can magnets detect burglars in your home?

[Blue flame of a natural gas cooker.]

### [Energy][40]

How does wind energy come from the Sun? Is nuclear power safe or not? Will the world ever run out of
energy? Why are we still so dependent on "fossil fuels"?

[Small steel spring flexed in a curve between two fingers.]

### [Engineering][41]

What stops a bridge falling over? Why can a person lift more stuff with a crane than with their bare
hands? What's the difference between hydraulics and pneumatics?

[Organic vegetable box]

### [Environment][42]

Can we still stop dangerous climate change? What causes air and water pollution and how can the
world clean up its act? Is organic food really "better"—and, if so, why?

[Sony Bravia flatscreen TV]

### [Gadgets][43]

How does a flash memory card store your holiday snaps? Why can a synthesizer mimic any musical
instrument that's ever been invented (and even ones that haven't been)?

[Blue, self-cleaning, heat-reflecting glass keeps a conservatory cool.]

### [Home life][44]

How can you make windows turn dark at the flick of a switch? If an energy-saving lamp saves energy,
how come it still makes exactly the same amount of light?

[Blue, self-cleaning, heat-reflecting glass keeps a conservatory cool.]

### [Materials][45]

If you had a piece of platinum as big as a man, how much would it be worth? Why doesn't a dry-stone
wall fall over? Is it true that glass is a kind of liquid?

[A rainbow-spectrum of colors on the surface of a soap bubble produced by thin-film interference.]

### [Science][46]

Which part of a candle flame is the hottest? Why does chocolate actually taste good? Where's the
best place to sit on a rollercoaster if you want to scare yourself to death?

[Close-up of hydraulic rams on a digger]

### [Tools, instruments, and measurement][47]

How does an iris scanner recognize your eyes? Why don't fireproof clothes catch fire? Can a robot
really learn to play drums?

[Front view of huge USAF C-17 globemaster plane waiting on a runway]

### [Transportation][48]

If a man can't fly, how can a plane fly if it weighs as much as 5000 men? How come we say a wheel
reduces friction if it's got a tire that grips the road? Why do huge ships float when even tiny bits
of metal sink?

## Who uses this site?

[Optical mouse circuit board with red LED light shining through light guide.]

In the ~20 years we've been online (2006–2026), pages from this site have been viewed over 140
million times in total. Our articles have been cited by [dozens of books][49] and [over 2000
academic papers and patents][50]. We've received over 4000 user [feedback forms][51] in the last
decade and 92% gave us four or five stars out of five—a weighted average of 4.6—but there's always
plenty of room to do better. We hope you find this site useful too!

## Follow us on your favorite sites!

Now you've found us, don't lose us. Why not join [our friendly Facebook page][52], where we post
cool science and technology news? You'll find our photos on [Flickr][53] and we're also on
[Pinterest][54].

In 2024 and 2025, we recorded a 50-episode podcast with audio versions of some of our articles.
Although it's currently on hiatus, you can still listen to the old episodes by [subscribing to our
podcast feed][55] in Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or your favorite player. Our podcast is free and
(because we host it on our own server) completely ad free!

## Tell your friends

If you've enjoyed this website, **please kindly tell your friends about us on your favorite social
sites**.

Press CTRL + D to bookmark this page for later, or [email the link to a friend][56].

## Privacy and cookies

Our website serves advertisements to pay its running costs. The advertisers we work with use a
technical mechanism called cookies (small files stored on your computer) to help them serve relevant
and useful advertisements that they think are likely to appeal to you, but you can opt in or out of
these cookies at any time. The web domain explainthatstuff.com does not collect, store, sell, or
share any personal information and has no plans ever to do so in the future. However, in line with
the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), you may still send us a ["Do Not Sell My Personal
Information"][57] request if you'd like to. For more details, please see our [privacy policy][58].
