Wheels with teeth carved around them can make you go faster or bump up your power—and here's how.

[A dry cell Ever Ready battery.]

### [Batteries][33]

We all need electricity, wherever we happen to be, so thank goodness for batteries—miniature power
plants you can carry in your pocket.

[A large electric motor from an electric lawn mower]

### [Electric motors][34]

These amazing machines turn electricity and magnetism into movement, powering everything from
handheld toothbrushes to bikes, cars, and trains.

[Conceptual artwork of a warming world.]

### [Global warming][35]

Climate scientists recently issued their strongest ever warning about the growing risks of
irreversible "global warming." If you find the subject baffling, try our easy-to-follow
introduction.

[Composite photo showing NASA supercomputer floating in a cloud]

### [Cloud computing][36]

Why buy yourself an expensive computer or programs to go with it when you can get access to
something just as good over the Internet? What are the benefits and drawbacks of working in "the
cloud"?

## What else is on our site?

The articles on our site are divided up into broad topical areas, listed below. We've also given you
a rough idea of the kind of questions you're going to find answers to in each section:

[Basic digital camera]

### [Communications][37]

Why do we bounce telephone calls off satellites? How do cellphones work? What's the difference
between digital radio and ordinary radio?

[Typical microcontroller microchip in a dual-in-line package.]

### [Computers][38]

How can you make a computer think like a human brain? Who invented the computer—and why on Earth did
it take them so long?

[A digital voltmeter standing with red and black probes attached, wired into a circuit to test a
simple 1.5-volt battery.]

### [Electricity and electronics][39]

What's the difference between "electric" and "electronic"? How can you make coffee with a stream of
electrons? How can magnets detect burglars in your home?

[Blue flame of a natural gas cooker.]

### [Energy][40]

How does wind energy come from the Sun? Is nuclear power safe or not? Will the world ever run out of
energy? Why are we still so dependent on "fossil fuels"?

[Small steel spring flexed in a curve between two fingers.]

### [Engineering][41]

What stops a bridge falling over? Why can a person lift more stuff with a crane than with their bare
hands? What's the difference between hydraulics and pneumatics?

[Organic vegetable box]

### [Environment][42]

Can we still stop dangerous climate change? What causes air and water pollution and how can the
world clean up its act? Is organic food really "better"—and, if so, why?

[Sony Bravia flatscreen TV]

### [Gadgets][43]

How does a flash memory card store your holiday snaps? Why can a synthesizer mimic any musical
instrument that's ever been invented (and even ones that haven't been)?

[Blue, self-cleaning, heat-reflecting glass keeps a conservatory cool.]

### [Home life][44]

How can you make windows turn dark at the flick of a switch? If an energy-saving lamp saves energy,
how come it still makes exactly the same amount of light?

[Blue, self-cleaning, heat-reflecting glass keeps a conservatory cool.]

### [Materials][45]

If you had a piece of platinum as big as a man, how much would it be worth? Why doesn't a dry-stone
wall fall over? Is it true that glass is a kind of liquid?

[A rainbow-spectrum of colors on the surface of a soap bubble produced by thin-film interference.]

### [Science][46]

Which part of a candle flame is the hottest? Why does chocolate actually taste good? Where's the
best place to sit on a rollercoaster if you want to scare yourself to death?

[Close-up of hydraulic rams on a digger]

### [Tools, instruments, and measurement][47]

How does an iris scanner recognize your eyes? Why don't fireproof clothes catch fire? Can a robot
really learn to play drums?

[Front view of huge USAF C-17 globemaster plane waiting on a runway]

### [Transportation][48]

If a man can't fly, how can a plane fly if it weighs as much as 5000 men? How come we say a wheel
reduces friction if it's got a tire that grips the road? Why do huge ships float when even tiny bits
of metal sink?

## Who uses this site?

[Optical mouse circuit board with red LED light shining through light guide.]

In the ~20 years we've been online (2006–2026), pages from this site have been viewed over 140
million times in total. Our articles have been cited by [dozens of books][49] and [over 2000
academic papers and patents][50]. We've received over 4000 user [feedback forms][51] in the last
decade and 92% gave us four or five stars out of five—a weighted average of 4.6—but there's always
plenty of room to do better. We hope you find this site useful too!

## Follow us on your favorite sites!

Now you've found us, don't lose us. Why not join [our friendly Facebook page][52], where we post
cool science and technology news? You'll find our photos on [Flickr][53] and we're also on
[Pinterest][54].

In 2024 and 2025, we recorded a 50-episode podcast with audio versions of some of our articles.
Although it's currently on hiatus, you can still listen to the old episodes by [subscribing to our
podcast feed][55] in Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or your favorite player. Our podcast is free and
(because we host it on our own server) completely ad free!

## Tell your friends

If you've enjoyed this website, **please kindly tell your friends about us on your favorite social
sites**.

Press CTRL + D to bookmark this page for later, or [email the link to a friend][56].

## Privacy and cookies

Our website serves advertisements to pay its running costs. The advertisers we work with use a
technical mechanism called cookies (small files stored on your computer) to help them serve relevant
and useful advertisements that they think are likely to appeal to you, but you can opt in or out of
these cookies at any time. The web domain explainthatstuff.com does not collect, store, sell, or
share any personal information and has no plans ever to do so in the future. However, in line with
the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), you may still send us a ["Do Not Sell My Personal
Information"][57] request if you'd like to. For more details, please see our [privacy policy][58].

Over nearly two centuries, we’ve transformed again and again – but always with a focus on materials.
From textiles to rubber, from dental and health to high-performance composites, our journey has been

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

# Your next dream job is here

Hirify is a job board and meta-aggregator of the best IT and Digital jobs.  Why Hirify is different
* We collect directly from career pages - we take vacancies straight from company sites, including
  custom career sites other aggregators do not reach.
* Updated every 2 hours - we cycle through our sources continuously, so new vacancies often appear
  here before they do on other platforms, including the big ones.
* Deduplication across 960+ Telegram channels - catches around 90% of duplicates, so the same job
  posted across dozens of channels usually does not repeat in your feed. We match title and company,
  contacts, vector similarity, and AI checks the borderline pairs.
* Smart filter - 15+ parameters (specialization, stack, domain, English, format, company type, geo),
  each with an exclude mode. You can also build the filter just by typing - AI parses a
  plain-language request.
* Telegram alerts - save as many filters as you want and get notified across all of them.
  Deduplication works here too: if a vacancy matches several of your filters, it arrives once, not
  as duplicates.

## Notre entreprise

Isola Composite, expert dans la fabrication de matériaux composites

Isola Composite est présent depuis plus d’un siècle sur le marché des matériaux d’isolation
électrique et thermique. Nous avons acquis au fil des années une solide expertise qui nous permet de
nous placer en tant que Leader au niveau international dans plusieurs de nos domaines d’activités.

## Innovation

Notre entreprise de matériaux composites développe, conçoit, fabrique et usine à la fois des
planches, profils et rouleaux de grandes longueurs de matériaux composites pour ensuite les usiner
en fonction des exigences et plans de nos clients dans les domaines de l'isolation électrique,
thermique, électronique, ainsi que dans bien d’autres domaines industriels.

Isola Composite est résolument tournée vers l’international avec son chiffre d'affaires de plus de
80% à l’export en travaillant tout autant avec des grands groupes internationaux … qu’avec des
entreprises dans des secteurs de niche ou des distributeurs et usiniers spécialisés.

## Votre fournisseur de matériaux composites

## engagé dans une démarche éco-responsable

Parce que nous croyons que ce sont les petits gestes de chacun qui ont de l’importance, Isola
Composite est depuis plusieurs années engagé notamment dans la proposition de matériaux dans le
domaine des nouvelles énergies. 



En interne, nos démarches éco-responsable sont multipliées par une rationalisation de l’organisation
de notre site, par la refonte de nos modes d’énergie en interne…



Par ailleurs, les matériaux composites que nous produisons, sont peu gourmands en matières premières
rares, et sont à la fois plus malléables et plus durables que d’autres matières utilisées dans le
domaine de l’isolation. En favorisant l’utilisation de ces nouvelles matières, nos clients réalisent
souvent qu’ils sont à la fois moins coûteux et moins sujet à la corrosion que les autres matières.

Nous fabriquons également au sein de nos usines des plaques d’isolants thermiques qui vont permettre
une isolation efficace et réduire les pertes en énergie. Ils permettent d’améliorer la note
énergétique d’un logement ou d’un local et donc de préserver l’environnement. Leur performance en
matière d’isolation et leur simplicité d’utilisation en font la meilleure solution d’isolation
actuellement sur le marché.

## Isola Composite est présent

## sur plusieurs secteurs d'activités

Au fil des années, Isola Composite a su diversifier son activité pour répondre aux besoins de ses
clients, entreprises comme particuliers.

Nous concevons et fabriquons désormais aussi bien des plaques isolantes en matériaux composites pour
les secteurs haute tension que des plaques frontales pour les piles à combustible hydrogène ou
l’isolation de conducteur dans les chargeurs de batterie. 



Nous avons su exploiter les propriétés des matériaux composites dans bien des domaines, et nous
avons pour vocation d’aller toujours plus loin. L’avenir est à nous …

## Notre entreprise

Isola Composite, expert dans la fabrication de matériaux composites

Isola Composite est présent depuis plus d’un siècle sur le marché des matériaux d’isolation
électrique et thermique. Nous avons acquis au fil des années une solide expertise qui nous permet de
nous placer en tant que Leader au niveau international dans plusieurs de nos domaines d’activités.

## Innovation

Notre entreprise de matériaux composites développe, conçoit, fabrique et usine à la fois des
planches, profils et rouleaux de grandes longueurs de matériaux composites pour ensuite les usiner
en fonction des exigences et plans de nos clients dans les domaines de l'isolation électrique,
thermique, électronique, ainsi que dans bien d’autres domaines industriels.

Isola Composite est résolument tournée vers l’international avec son chiffre d'affaires de plus de
80% à l’export en travaillant tout autant avec des grands groupes internationaux … qu’avec des
entreprises dans des secteurs de niche ou des distributeurs et usiniers spécialisés.

## Votre fournisseur de matériaux composites

## engagé dans une démarche éco-responsable

Parce que nous croyons que ce sont les petits gestes de chacun qui ont de l’importance, Isola
Composite est depuis plusieurs années engagé notamment dans la proposition de matériaux dans le
domaine des nouvelles énergies. 



En interne, nos démarches éco-responsable sont multipliées par une rationalisation de l’organisation
de notre site, par la refonte de nos modes d’énergie en interne…



Par ailleurs, les matériaux composites que nous produisons, sont peu gourmands en matières premières
rares, et sont à la fois plus malléables et plus durables que d’autres matières utilisées dans le
domaine de l’isolation. En favorisant l’utilisation de ces nouvelles matières, nos clients réalisent
souvent qu’ils sont à la fois moins coûteux et moins sujet à la corrosion que les autres matières.

Nous fabriquons également au sein de nos usines des plaques d’isolants thermiques qui vont permettre
une isolation efficace et réduire les pertes en énergie. Ils permettent d’améliorer la note
énergétique d’un logement ou d’un local et donc de préserver l’environnement. Leur performance en
matière d’isolation et leur simplicité d’utilisation en font la meilleure solution d’isolation
actuellement sur le marché.

## Isola Composite est présent

## sur plusieurs secteurs d'activités

Au fil des années, Isola Composite a su diversifier son activité pour répondre aux besoins de ses
clients, entreprises comme particuliers.

Nous concevons et fabriquons désormais aussi bien des plaques isolantes en matériaux composites pour
les secteurs haute tension que des plaques frontales pour les piles à combustible hydrogène ou
l’isolation de conducteur dans les chargeurs de batterie. 



Nous avons su exploiter les propriétés des matériaux composites dans bien des domaines, et nous
avons pour vocation d’aller toujours plus loin. L’avenir est à nous …



En diversifiant notre production, nous sommes en constante recherche des innovations qui feront
l’industrie de demain. Isola Composite met pour cela toute son expertise au service de la recherche
dans le domaine des matériaux composites pour améliorer sa production et proposer des produits
toujours plus performants.

Isola Composite est également présent sur le marché de l’électronique, et est l’unique producteur
des produits de la marque CDM depuis plus de 40 ans. Nous concevons et nous réalisons pour eux des
outillages destinés à optimiser l’assemblage des circuits imprimés.

## Leading The Way

For over 75 years!

**JPS Composite Materials is a world-leading manufacturer of composite reinforcement and para-aramid
fabrics. Our high-strength composite reinforcement fabrics can be found in aerospace interior and
exterior structures, consumer and industrial electronics, recreational & sporting goods, automotive
materials, composite parts, and many other industries and applications. JPS Composite Materials
proudly sets the standard for fiberglass composite reinforcements.**

How KPI Supports Projects

## From Concept to Custom Manufacturing

KPI Concepts helps businesses move from project idea to finished product with design support,
material planning, in-house manufacturing capabilities, finishing, assembly, and production
coordination.

As a premier contract manufacturing partner specializing in custom store fixtures and commercial
cabinetry. We combine multi-plant capacity with precision engineering to deliver scalable,
high-volume production for brands nationwide.
01

### Design Review

Support for drawings, product requirements, fixture needs, dimensions, and project planning.

02

### Material Planning

Wood, metal, foam, laminate, finish, and component planning based on the project application.

03

### Manufacturing Partner

Custom production for store fixtures, checklanes, cabinets, displays, metal parts, and foam
products.

04

### Finishing & Assembly

Finishing, assembly, quality checks, and production coordination for commercial-ready solutions.

Why KPI Concepts

## & Commercial Millwork
## Built for High-Volume Rollouts

KPI Concepts combines decades of U.S. manufacturing experience with in-house capabilities across
store fixtures, cabinetry, millwork, metal fabrication, foam products, finishing, assembly, and
project support.

  dry fiber materials for automatic lamination (AFP) and infusion and RTM applications. MTorres
  solutions are ideal for the efficient introduction of composites in new industrial sectors.
  
  ][80]
* [
  
  ### Prototypes and pre-series
  
  MTorres has a large number of technologies related to composite materials that make us the ideal
  partner for the manufacturing needs of prototypes and pre-series composite materials through a
  completely industrial process.
  
  ][81]
* [
  
  ### Tools and molds
  
  For more than 25 years, MTorres has developed tools and molds necessary for the processing of
  composite materials for a large number of projects in multiple sectors (aerospace, wind power,
  naval,…).
  
  ][82]
* [
  
  ### TorresPrint3D® - Additive manufacturing
  
  MTorres has its own patented technology for the manufacture of large components through additive
  manufacturing, which allows us to solve any need for large-scale tools quickly and economically.
  
  ][83]

## Portfolio

### Check our Portfolio

Here are the devices developed by Technovotum which are successfully used for testing of composite
materials in various industries.
* All
* Portable
* Robotic
* Transducers

#### DAMI-C09

MIA (mechanical impedance analysis) flaw detector for aviation materials - **DAMI-С09 **– is
intended for detection of laminations, discontinuities, defects of lack-of-adhesion type and other
continuity faults in multi-layer polymeric composite materials (PCM), honeycomb structures with
various fillers, as well as for revealing of corrosion spots, surface and subsurface flaws in
various metal structures.

#### СHAMELEON 32+

Ultrasonic phased array (PA) flaw detector with digital signal focusing and automatic determination
of flaw dimensions and location coordinates is intended to control the quality of metal and
composite materials in transport, oil-gas, nuclear energy, machine-building and other industrial
branches.

#### RS-1-02

Separate-combined impedance transducers have higher sensitivity compared to combined transducers and
are used for nondestructive testing of composite materials in conjunction with **DAMI-С09** flaw
detector and **TERI** impedance tester.

#### PADI-8-02K

The **PADI-8-02K** transducer is designed to detect non-adhesive and delamination defects in
adhesive-bonded composite materials, cellular structures based on metals, carbon fiber plastics, and
fiberglass, in various combinations with one-way access.

#### SLIDER M1

The** SLIDER M1** and **SLIDER M2** scanners are a mechanical system of two-axis dimensioning of
"hand" type, designed for probe movement trajectory tracking across a testing surface.

#### EMK-4-02_20001

Dielectric impermeability probe EMK-4-02_20001. It is designed to test pieces made of conductive
materials at devices of DAMI series, to search for conductive inclusions, water, and other
unintended inclusions.

#### ROBOSCOP VTM-5000/ORBITA

The laser scanning and flaw detection equipment **ROBOSKOP VTM-5000 / ORBITA **is designed for
non-destructive testing of aircraft engine parts of various range by type and size.

#### ROBOSKOP VTM-5000/COMPOZITE

The laser scanning and flaw detection bench **ROBOSCOP VTM-5000/COMPOZITE **is designed for the
non-destructive testing of polymer-composite materials used in aircraft constructions: glider
elements, helicopter blades, honeycomb panels It is also applicable in wind power engineering,
small-sized shipbuilding, pipe fitting production, etc.

#### ROBOSKOP VTM-5000/COMPOZITE

non-destructive testing of polymer-composite materials used in aircraft constructions: glider
elements, helicopter blades, honeycomb panels It is also applicable in wind power engineering,
small-sized shipbuilding, pipe fitting production, etc.

* What methods are used for diagnostics?
  
  Ultrasonic, phased array ultrasonic, eddy current, impedance, impact, laser gaging – these methods
  are supported by the equipment. Each method can be reasonable depending on test object material,
  testing time, industrial standards and physical conditions. Our specialists can help with choosing
  an optimal method.
* How is Technical support and service provided ?
  
  Customers can send their inquiries to our e-mail address [votummarketing@gmail.com][23]
* What materials are tested ?
  
  - Polymer materials (PCM)
  - Metal plastics
  - Carbon fiber plastics
  - Ceramic
* How to choose a set of equipment ?
  
  Visit our web-site, choose a product you are interested, press “make an order” (“cart” icon).
* What is the lading time?
  
  All basiс sets and standard accessories are usually on stock and can be shipped within 5 days. On
  special items the lading time is up to 7 weeks.
* How long is the warranty period and does it cover all items?
  
  The standard warranty period is 18 months for instruments and 6 months for accessories. Warranty
  does not cover consumables.

## NTPT : High-Performance and lightweight Parts

NTPT is manufacturing of high-end composite parts. As a fully integrated composite supplier, we
offer prototyping and serial production. NTPT ensures that high-performance, lightweight composite
parts are delivered timely and with high quality.

Materials

## Customized composite materials

The foundation of NTPT is unidirectional prepreg. Whether thin or thick ply, **high performance** or
**durable**, we can customize the material to fit your application. We can also ease your
**monolithic** or **sandwich** parts manufacturing by offering prepreg preform (kit).

## ** RaxPanel: Durable & Reliable** **Sandwich Panel Manufacturer**

Based in China, RaxPanel is a technology company specializing in high-quality composite panel
solutions and lightweight materials. Our diverse product range includes CFRT Sandwich Panels,
GRP/FRP Honeycomb Panels, Foam Core Panels, and specialized Aluminum Sandwich Panels. We provide a
comprehensive single-source solution by integrating R&D, design, and production. Unlike competitors
with limited offerings, we leverage over 15 years of manufacturing experience to offer bespoke
designs tailored to specific needs, from RV and truck body solutions to marine and industrial
applications.

Our commitment to quality is backed by our own factory, featuring an advanced composite panel
production line capable of producing over 2,500 square meters daily. We continuously monitor market
trends to innovate and launch new products, ensuring our materials are lighter, stronger, and more
environmentally friendly. Our professional international sales team offers 24-hour, one-to-one
service, guiding clients from product design and cost reduction to managing transportation risks,
ensuring timely deliveries to over 30 countries worldwide.

At RaxPanel, we provide manufacturers and distributors with high-performing, cost-effective
composite materials. We ensure exceptional performance under the most demanding conditions by
embracing continuous improvement in our production and customer service practices. Our ability to
develop custom solutions is unique; our engineers conduct experimental testing and offer a rich
variety of core and skin materials to meet specific data standards and project requirements for our
global clientele.

## ** RaxPanel: Durable & Reliable** **Sandwich Panel Manufacturer**

Based in China, RaxPanel is a technology company specializing in high-quality composite panel
solutions and lightweight materials. Our diverse product range includes CFRT Sandwich Panels,
GRP/FRP Honeycomb Panels, Foam Core Panels, and specialized Aluminum Sandwich Panels. We provide a
comprehensive single-source solution by integrating R&D, design, and production. Unlike competitors
with limited offerings, we leverage over 15 years of manufacturing experience to offer bespoke
designs tailored to specific needs, from RV and truck body solutions to marine and industrial
applications.

Our commitment to quality is backed by our own factory, featuring an advanced composite panel
production line capable of producing over 2,500 square meters daily. We continuously monitor market
trends to innovate and launch new products, ensuring our materials are lighter, stronger, and more
environmentally friendly. Our professional international sales team offers 24-hour, one-to-one
service, guiding clients from product design and cost reduction to managing transportation risks,
ensuring timely deliveries to over 30 countries worldwide.

At RaxPanel, we provide manufacturers and distributors with high-performing, cost-effective
composite materials. We ensure exceptional performance under the most demanding conditions by
embracing continuous improvement in our production and customer service practices. Our ability to
develop custom solutions is unique; our engineers conduct experimental testing and offer a rich
variety of core and skin materials to meet specific data standards and project requirements for our
global clientele.

COMPANY PROFILE

Beijing Red Sun Technology Co., Ltd.

Beijing Red Sun Technology Co., Ltd. ("RDS Technology") is a premium manufacturer of insulation and
advanced composite materials. Our core product lines include glass fiber and carbon fiber reinforced
molding parts, alongside glass, cotton, and paper reinforced laminates, rods, and tubes. We also
specialize in high-thermal resistant products, engineering plastics, plastic injection, and custom
deep-fabrication for all types of composite materials.

### SINCE 2009

Backed by advanced production lines and experienced engineers, we ensure that every product strictly
complies with international standards. Our highly efficient and professional team guarantees a
seamless procurement experience and reliable solutions tailored to your specific requirements.

We are proud to serve a growing network of global partners across different countries, and we
welcome more enterprises to join us.

RDS Technology builds long-lasting relationships driven by our core principles: **"Mutual
Benefit"**, **"Quality First"**, and **"Better Ethics"**.

RDS, your reliable partner.

We supply and install all major metal deck profiles across roof decking and floor decking. Need
something specific or non-standard? We'll recommend the best metal decking product, or a structural
alternative that meets your spec and budget.

## How Can We Help You?

## [At RMD Profiles, we supply and install steel decks across the UK: structural roof decking and
## composite floor decking. With over 12,000 projects completed and 120,000 m² of decking installed,
## our reputation is built on quality, responsiveness and value-engineered solutions.][67]

### Supply Only Decking - Fast, Flexible, Stocked
* **Ideal for: Contractors, Builders, Buyers**
  
  If you’ve got your drawings or a cut list ready, we’ll handle the rest.
  
  We stock popular composite floor profiles and roof decking, including MetFloor, TATA RoofDek and
  more.
* Next-day urgent delivery available
* Edge trims made to order
* Send your cut list - we’ll supply decking, trims or studs
* Need help? Send a drawing, and we’ll prep your cut list for you

[ Find Out More About Floor Supply Only ][68]
[ Find Out More About Roof Supply Only ][69]

#### Supply Only + Design Support

**Ideal for: Engineers, Designers, Architects, Self-Builders**

Need design help with your floor or roof deck layout?
We work directly from your GA or DWG drawings to ensure the right profile and efficient design.
* Full design + supply service
* DWG/GA-based profile layout design
* 
  Buy Back Scheme for unused materials
* Advice on install and site sequencing

[ Find Out More About Floor Supply & Design ][70]
[ Find Out More About Roof Supply & Design ][71]

#### Supply & Fix Packages - Complete Install Service

**Ideal for: Commercial Developers, Main Contractors**

Our experienced install teams provide full supply and fix solutions with optional concrete, fall
protection, and welding.
* Composite floor or roof decking installed to spec
* Certified stud welding (thru-deck or STB)
* Safety netting & airbag fall arrest systems
* Design engineering support included

[ Find Out More About Floor Supply & Fix ][72]
[ Find Out More About Roof Supply & Fix ][73]

## Additional Services

## **More than just metal deck profiles: complete support for your project**

###  

### At RMD Profiles, we do more than supply and install metal deck profiles. Our additional services
### are built to simplify your process, cut cost and keep the project moving: expert stud welding,
### made-to-measure edge trims, sustainable options like our Buy Back Scheme, and access to the
### tools you need on site.

## Stud Welding

[metal deck profiles]

Through-deck or straight-to-beam stud welding by certified operatives, fixing the shear studs that
lock slab and steel into composite action. Fast, safe and compliant with [BS EN][74] and SCI codes.
Available across all metal deck profiles, on supply-and-fix or labour-only packages.

##  Edge Trim & Flashing

[steel decks]

Made-to-measure edge trims, closure plates and flashings, cut to suit the perimeter of your roof
decking or floor decking. A clean, watertight slab edge that improves weather sealing and slab
performance, supplied to fit every metal deck profile we hold.

[LEARN MORE][75]

[steel decks]

### Tool Services to Hire

Hire the kit you need to install metal decking on site: screw guns, deck fixing kits & essential
site equipment. Everything to fix roof decking & floor decking quickly and to spec, without buying
tools you’ll only use once.

[LEARN MORE][76]

[Surplus metal decking buy back scheme]

### Buy Back Scheme

We buy back surplus and offcut metal decking. Our team surveys, prices and collects leftover deck
from site and pays more than the scrap man, keeping usable material out of the skip.

[LEARN MORE][77]

[Fall arrest safety system for metal decking installation]

### Fall Arrest System

Protect your site team during metal decking installation with certified safety netting and airbags.
Fully compliant with UK working-at-height regulations, so your roof and floor deck goes down safely,
whatever the span.

Von Textilien über Haushaltsgeräte und Lebensmittel bis hin zu elektronischen Geräten – verifizieren
Sie die Qualität, Rechtskonformität und Sicherheit Ihrer Produkte entlang globalen Lieferketten.

Nachhaltigkeit

und an andere Bereiche der nachhaltigen Entwicklung erfüllen.

Schöpfen Sie das volle Potenzial Ihrer MitarbeiterInnen aus, um wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und gute
Angestellte langfristig an Ihr Unternehmen zu binden. Nutzen Sie die verschiedenen Medien und
Trainingsmethoden unsere SGS Academy.

Unser Angebot für Sie: Präsenztrainings, Virtuelle Trainings, Inhouse Trainings und E-Learning.
Informieren Sie sich hier.

## Wasseranalytik

Zu unseren Aufgaben bei SGS gehört es, Wasser regelmäßig zu prüfen, zu analysieren und zu bewerten.

hochprofessionelle Wasseruntersuchungen.

Ihr Erfolg ist unser Ziel!

## Die richtigen Services für Ihre Branche

[

### Industrie und Umwelt

Wir unterstützen industrielle Unternehmen ihrer Verantwortung gegenüber Mitarbeitern, Kunden, Umwelt
und Behörden gerecht zu werden. Dafür liefern wir zuverlässige Testergebnisse und arbeiten global
nach den höchsten Standards.

[Arrow right]
][174] [

### Gesundheit und Ernährung

Wir prüfen, inspizieren und zertifizieren seit Jahrzehnten für Unternehmen in der Gesundheits- und
Ernährungsbranche. So unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei Produkte schnell und sicher auf den Markt
zu bringen.

[Arrow right]
][175] [

### Konsumgüter und Handel

Wir bieten das weltweit umfangreichste Angebot an Inspektions-, Prüf- und
Zertifizierungsdienstleistungen an und unterstützen Sie in jeder Phase: Vom Entwurf über die
Produktion und die Einhaltung von Vorschriften bis hin zum Import und Export von Waren.

[Arrow right]
][176] [

### Automotive

Das Automotive Testhouse ist Partner und unabhängige Schnittstelle zwischen Zulieferer und OEM. Wir
bieten alle wichtigen Prüfungen, sowie die Prüf- und Projektplanung bis hin zur Bewertung und
Interpretation von Ergebnissen, aus einer Hand.

[Arrow right]
][177]

Suche Suchen

## Was ist die SGS-Gruppe?

SGS ist das weltweit führende Prüf-, Inspektions- und Zertifizierungsunternehmen. Mit einem Netzwerk
von über 2.500 Standorten in 115 Ländern und 100.000 Mitarbeitenden bietet SGS seit über 145 Jahren
präzise und zuverlässige Dienstleistungen. 

Unter dem Motto „When you need to be sure“ fördert SGS höchste Standards in Qualität, Sicherheit und
Nachhaltigkeit, unterstützt durch spezialisierte Marken wie Brightsight, Bluesign und Nutrasource. 

### SGS Unternehmen in Deutschland

In Deutschland gehören zur SGS-Gruppe u.a. die Unternehmen **SGS INSTITUT FRESENIUS, SGS Analytics,
SGS Analytics LAG, SGS Chemie-, Industrie- und Spezialanalytik, SGS TÜV Saar, SGS proderm und SGS
Germany.** Zusammen bedienen die Gesellschaften alle Branchen über die geografischen Grenzen
Deutschlands hinaus. 

Das SGS INSTITUT FRESENIUS gehört dabei zu den führenden Anbietern für nicht-medizinische
Laboranalytik in Europa. Unsere Kompetenz zeigt sich in mehr als 180 Zertifizierungen,
Akkreditierungen und Zulassungen sowie in über 175 Jahren Erfahrung im Analytikbereich. Dieses
herausragende Wissen begründet – in Deutschland und international - unseren exzellenten Ruf bei
Herstellern, Handel, Dienstleistungsunternehmen und Endverbrauchern.

## Was ist die SGS-Gruppe?

SGS ist das weltweit führende Prüf-, Inspektions- und Zertifizierungsunternehmen. Mit einem Netzwerk
von über 2.500 Standorten in 115 Ländern und 100.000 Mitarbeitenden bietet SGS seit über 145 Jahren
präzise und zuverlässige Dienstleistungen. 

Unter dem Motto „When you need to be sure“ fördert SGS höchste Standards in Qualität, Sicherheit und
Nachhaltigkeit, unterstützt durch spezialisierte Marken wie Brightsight, Bluesign und Nutrasource. 

### SGS Unternehmen in Deutschland

In Deutschland gehören zur SGS-Gruppe u.a. die Unternehmen **SGS INSTITUT FRESENIUS, SGS Analytics,
SGS Analytics LAG, SGS Chemie-, Industrie- und Spezialanalytik, SGS TÜV Saar, SGS proderm und SGS
Germany.** Zusammen bedienen die Gesellschaften alle Branchen über die geografischen Grenzen
Deutschlands hinaus. 

Das SGS INSTITUT FRESENIUS gehört dabei zu den führenden Anbietern für nicht-medizinische
Laboranalytik in Europa. Unsere Kompetenz zeigt sich in mehr als 180 Zertifizierungen,
Akkreditierungen und Zulassungen sowie in über 175 Jahren Erfahrung im Analytikbereich. Dieses
herausragende Wissen begründet – in Deutschland und international - unseren exzellenten Ruf bei
Herstellern, Handel, Dienstleistungsunternehmen und Endverbrauchern.

environment during composite manufacturing. These materials include bagging films, sealant tapes,
peelplies, breathers, infusion meshes, connectors, hoses, and other process supplies that help
control pressure, resin flow, air removal, and release.

## Import and export with us is easy

### Step by step plan for import and export

###### Search for a supplier

We will find a reliable supplier and organize delivery from our own warehouse or production
facility.

###### transaction execution

We will help you conclude a foreign trade transaction, prepare permitting documentation, and obtain
all necessary permits, certificates, and licenses.

###### payments in any currency

We will make payment under the contract in dollars, euros, yuan or any other currency worldwide.
Payment execution period is 3-4 business days. Commission from 3% depending on the payment amount.

###### logistics for foreign trade

We will take care of all logistics and customs clearance in accordance with Incoterms 2020 delivery
terms.

###### our responsibility

We are responsible for the entire process of exporting your products, as well as for transport and
customs operations and all the paperwork. We inform you about the delivery of goods in real time.

###### obligations

We guarantee strict compliance with contractual obligations and deadlines for import or export
deliveries.

**Weerg has 25 HP Multi Jet Fusion 5620 Pro printers, an advanced 3D printing solution for
high-precision industrial applications.**

**Touch and Feel**:** **the surface of the printed parts is smoother and more pleasant to the touch,
contributing to a higher quality of finish.

**+10% mechanical strength**: The HP Multi Jet Fusion 5620 Pro has achieved a 10% enhancement in the
mechanical properties of printed materials compared to its previous model. This improvement results
in stronger and more durable parts that can better withstand mechanical stress and wear over time.

**Quality assured from the initial prototype to mass production**: Our technology ensures optimized
repeatability and reliability, delivering consistent and uniform results across various batches.
Ideal for series production that demands uniform quality.
